(xtask is а binary-only crate — `[[bin]] name = "xtask"` with no `[lib]` target;
`cargo public-api` cannot inspect a binary-only crate ("error: no library targets
found in package `xtask`"). The xtask binary surface is structurally unobservable
via public-api tooling. Reconciled-as-skipped at session 148 cursor visit per
per-crate protocol step 5b "tooling failed" handling; cursor advanced xtask →
buffer (cycle wrap). This placeholder is intentionally permanent — subsequent
cursor visits к xtask will continue to skip + advance.)
